title: When the Clock Wakes
author: Cyrus Halloran
blurb: August Sandoval, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
